scope: current-model historical Task A FP/FN only; frame observations, not unique objects

operating_point.nms: historical class-aware NMS; use stored outputs, no inference
operating_point.external: potato-only truth and predictions filtered before matching; stone NOT_SCORED

roster.derivation: unmatched prediction -> FP; unmatched truth -> FN; wrong-class match -> predicted-class FP and truth-class FN
roster.authority: derive from stored matches; independently verify greedy matching and label coordinates; never force expected counts
roster.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False sort_keys=True separators=(',',':') allow_nan=False
roster.error_id: sha256(canonical identity) prefixed err-; identity binds model bytes, source path/hash, label path/hash, GT/pred array hashes, complete match-state hash, split/image/class/type, GT/pred indices and actual original xyxy
roster.immutability: exclusive-create errors.json and renders; protocol bytes unchanged; roster SHA256 covers ordered identities and IDs, independent of visual annotations; changed input requires a new version, never overwrite

size_bins.coordinate_space: original image pixels, xyxy, no inclusive +1
size_bins.area: (x2-x1)*(y2-y1); FP uses prediction, FN uses GT
size_bins.interpretation: descriptive error counts only; not AP, COCO evaluation, physical millimeters, or complete stratified performance

visual_annotation.annotator: AI assistant; not human expert truth
visual_annotation.blinding: errors, GT and predictions visible; posthoc diagnostic analysis, not blind new ground truth

visible_occlusion.rule: yes only for a visible object partly hidden by another visible object; no when identifiable object has no visible occluder; unknown when uncertain; not_applicable for no identifiable target object

actual_frame_truncated_object.rule: judge object continuation beyond original frame, not crop border or box touching border; yes only visible continuation at actual frame edge, unknown if ambiguous; not_applicable for no identifiable target object

background_tags.rule: visible local context at error box/crop; tags describe context, never establish cause

issue_observation.rule: tentative observation, not forced causal truth; possible_duplicate requires visible overlap/same object context; possible_annotation_issue never changes stored GT; small uses original pixel bin; unclear when evidence insufficient

rendering.full_frame: all original pixels at 1:1 plus 64px legend header; original GT green solid, stored prediction magenta dashed; target yellow outer outline; indices/classes and confidence shown
rendering.crop: integer floor/ceil of target xyxy expanded by max(48px, 0.6*max(box width,height)) on each side, clipped to original frame; resize longest side to 768px using bicubic; add 64px legend
rendering.transform: store original crop xyxy, output content width/height, scale_x/scale_y, header offset and forward/inverse affine matrices; no letterboxing
rendering.overlay: all stored GT/pred intersecting viewport, not fabricated boxes; GT/pred retain separate color and line style; labels clipped to canvas
rendering.pixels: source image pixels only, no synthetic masks, generated objects or segmentation

validation: actual counts and per-class counts agree with stored summary and historical metrics
all 189 frame caches and source/label hashes captured and unchanged
GT agrees with original YOLO label coordinates and source manifests
stored matching equals independent confidence-ranked greedy matching at IoU 0.5
model hash agrees with historical and comparison provenance
each error identity, index, bbox, area bin and SHA256 reconstructs from stored evidence
each full-frame/crop path exists, decodes, has correct dimensions and recorded transform
all visual observations identify viewed diagnostic paths and conform to frozen enums
